meta.name: api-contract-testing
meta.description: Verify API contracts between services to ensure compatibility and prevent breaking changes. Use for contract testing, Pact, API contract validation, schema validation, and consumer-driven contracts.

copy.tagline: 验证服务间API契约，防止破坏性变更
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在微服务间保证API兼容性
copy.tagline_en: Verify API contracts between services to prevent breaking changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ensure API compatibility between microservices

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你验证 API 契约，确保服务间的请求/响应格式和数据类型兼容，防止因服务变更导致其他依赖服务出错。
howto.when: 当你需要测试微服务间通信、防止 API 破坏性变更、或验证消费者与提供者之间的契约时触发。

say.text: 帮我验证用户服务API契约
say.note: Claude 将启动契约测试并检查一致性。

say.text: 用Pact测试订单服务与用户服务的契约
say.note: Claude 会生成消费者驱动的契约测试。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude helps you verify API contracts to ensure request/response formats and data types are compatible between services, preventing breaking changes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to test microservices communication, prevent breaking API changes, or validate consumer-provider contracts.

say_en.text: Help me verify the user service API contract
say_en.note: Claude will run contract tests and check consistency.

say_en.text: Use Pact to test contract between OrderService and UserService
say_en.note: Claude will generate consumer-driven contract tests.
